events.name: Petno gives Q3 guidance at conference

12.text: JPMorgan reported a decent quarter with a compounding franchise, flagged higher rate risks to its balance sheet, and its analysts added Meta to the Analyst Focus List while removing Alphabet, named ViaSat top mid-cap telecom pick, and cut GE Vernova's price target to $1,000.

13.text: JPMorgan projects Bitcoin growing 10% annually in a base case and 17% in a bull case, potentially reaching $150,000 by 2030. Morgan Stanley separately tokenized U.S. equities, advancing bank-led tokenization that JPMorgan has also pursued.

7.text: Big bank Q3 earnings show strong consumer spending, improved credit quality, and rising profits from higher rates. JPMorgan is cited as a diversified buy pick, though it's barely mentioned beyond that.

4.text: JPMorgan is leading Anthropic's IPO with Dimon appearing alongside its CEO, while Dimon reaffirmed dollar dominance. Democrats will probe the bank's Epstein ties, it may sell $2 billion of Qualtrics debt at a discount, donated $1.75 million to veteran entrepreneurs, and expects slower 2027 M&A.

16.text: JPMorganChase CFO Jeremy Barnum will present at the Goldman Sachs Financial Services Conference on December 9, 2026. Separately, J.P. Morgan Payments was named Best in Class in Javelin's 2026 biometric authentication scorecard, and several companies will present at J.P. Morgan's Ultimate Services conference.

5.text: JPMorgan analysts adjusted price targets and ratings across several stocks: trimming Keurig Dr Pepper and Barclays targets, maintaining bullish views on Astera Labs and Palantir (initiating buy with $262 target), and downgrading reinsurers Hannover Re and Munich Re on weaker pricing. JPMorgan and Citi also said Metlen Energy's growth drivers remain on track.
